planets.name: TOI-1839 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1839 with a 1.42-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-1839 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1839. Its orbit and size follow Castro-González et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
